summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (hex-prefixed identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, dictionary-keyed function wrappers) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` into a temp directory and immediately invokes it via `execFileSync` against a package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-bundled module (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using shuffled integer/string-array decoding, hex-mangled identifiers, and `with(){}` blocks to defeat strict-mode parsers and deobfuscators. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and using it to execute a bundled, heavily obfuscated sibling module bypasses Node-based static and runtime scanners and has no relationship to the package's advertised ESLint-plugin purpose. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: `npm install` of this version resolves to install-time execution of attacker-staged code inside a runtime that was itself fetched during the install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
